title: Document coordinated vulnerability response in enterprise support
body:
## Summary

- document coordinated vulnerability response for covered release lines
- keep private vulnerability reporting available to everyone while explaining the named contacts and coordination an enterprise agreement adds
- cover impact assessment, mitigations, patched releases, advisories, CVEs, and disclosure

## Validation

- rendered through unified-docs in a production build
- checked at desktop and mobile viewport widths
